packageRules.description: All LinuxServer.io images use non-SemVer compound tag formats. Apply loose versioning, exclude nightly/development builds, and exclude stale Ubuntu-era tags (e.g. '14.3.9.xxx...ubuntu20.04.1-ls166') which sort higher than real app-version tags under loose versioning.
servercontainers/samba uses a custom composite tag format (e.g. a3.23.4-s4.22.8-r0). Loose versioning prevents misidentification.
pgvector uses channel tags like 'pg16' — not version numbers. Disable updates entirely to prevent bogus PRs.
Images pinned to a build-variant suffix (e.g. '-full') must only update within that same variant. Detected automatically via matchCurrentValue — no package list needed.
Group all non-major Docker updates into a single PR to reduce noise.
Major Docker updates always get individual PRs for manual review.
